correctness.rationale: The defining logical join is exactly union independence, with negatives intentionally ignored. For the independence face poset, Boolean interval Möbius inversion gives an exact integer-unimodular congruence to link Euler weights. Nonempty links are unions of paths and yield only 0 and unit weights; the empty link gives 2cos(n pi/3). The cyclic gap generating series (z^2+z^3)/(1-z^3) yields rank s_n+1-3[3|n], with s_n=s_(n-2)+2s_(n-3), and exactly one factor 2 in lengths divisible by three. Direct exact integer Smith tests for n=4..10 plus link weight counts to n=19 corroborate, not replace, all-size proof.

originality.rationale: The named-type positive-join matrix, its exact all-cycle integral Smith form, and its cubic rank sequence were not covered in actual published-finding corpus and source comparisons. value.rationale: Consistent positive-literal joins provide a natural operation on one-point type requirements in a canonical homogeneous structure. The all-size rank formula is a nontrivial cyclic gap enumeration, determines the exact characteristic-two rank defect, and separates a unique order-two Smith factor from zero factors. This is a precise natural invariant for every induced cycle base and a link between definability constraints and integral Euler arithmetic, not a finite-table recomputation.
